Legend of the degree of reliability

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Air conditioning

  • Device: Air conditioning refrigerant pipe and heat exchanger return pipe

  • Fault: Noise (buzzing) from the engine compartment when accelerating from 1200 to 2500 rpm

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Contact between the air conditioning refrigerant pipe and the heat exchanger return pipe

• Procedure: Place a strip of felt in the contact area between the two pipes, securing it to each pipe with a pipe clamp

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The pipes in question are located at the front left of the engine compartment, on the driver's side.

    Felt code no. 51452353024.

    Hose clamp code no. 07129952117
